date_note: The page shows only a relative timestamp and says the customer notice was issued on Wednesday; 25 November is taken as the publication day. The date of the intrusion is not stated.
title: Ochsner Sport says hackers accessed customer data from its online store
summary: Ochsner Sport says hackers accessed customer data from purchases in its online store, according to Keystone-SDA via bluewin.ch. A second bluewin.ch article says Dosenbach and parent company Deichmann were also affected. Ochsner says the data includes names, addresses, invoices, contact details and payment method used, but not passwords or payment information, and that it blocked the access and patched the exploited vulnerability.
plain: Ochsner Sport says hackers accessed some customer data from its online store. It says passwords and payment information were not affected and it has seen no sign of misuse.
exec: Ochsner Sport says online-store customer data was accessed; it says it has blocked the access and patched the flaw. bluewin.ch says Dosenbach and Deichmann were also affected.
action: As Ochsner Sport advises, be cautious with unexpected emails, letters or calls posing as the company, and carefully verify unexpected messages and payment requests.

validation.note: Only bluewin.ch (Keystone-SDA), quoting Ochsner Sport's customer notice, was read; the notice itself could not be loaded and no number of affected customers is given.
